details: Hwi-lib@1.0.2 runs a postinstall hook that harvests the installer's credentials and exfiltrates them. On install it reads ~/.env, ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, SSH private keys (~/.ssh/id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa), the Solana wallet (~/.config/solana/id.json) and Ethereum keystore (~/.ethereum/keystore), then recursively scans every hidden directory in the home folder for files matching wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private or ending in.json/.pem. It bundles the hostname, username, and all collected file contents into a JSON payload and POSTs it over HTTPS to webhook[.]site/5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4. The package ships no real library code.
